g.text: 150 annual observations · seed 1 vs seed 3 · fixed growth / open field
Same engine HEAD 5fb1aeb · identical per-panel axes for both seeds · no smoothing · no causal or mortality-rate inference
Top four: boundary snapshots 1301–1450. Commands: intervals 1300–1449. Famine delta: ending boundary 1301–1450.
Famine: consecutive retained-death count difference; famine_year excluded. SHA256 and field definitions: companion REPORT / VALIDATION.
